title: The canonical Roos, strict-limit and intrinsic Koszul units agree
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $A=\mathcal O_E$ and a uniformizer $t=\varpi_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For a scheme $W$ use the small pro-etale site, the completed ring sheaf $R_W=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(A/t^n)_W$, the constant quotient sheaves $S_{W,n}=(A/t^n)_W$ and the unbounded derived category $D(R_W)$ of sheaves of $R_W$-modules [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. All quotient modules are restricted to $R_W$ along the specified limit projections. Let $W$ be any scheme and $K\in D(R_W)$. For a flat-term K-flat representative $P$ of $K$, set $U_n=P\otimes_{R_W}S_{W,n}$ and $V_n=P\otimes_{R_W}[R_W\xrightarrow{t^n}R_W]$, with quotient transitions on $U$ and $(t,1)$ on the two-term factors of $V$. Write $\mathsf C(Z)=\operatorname{Cone}(1-s:\prod Z_n\to\prod Z_n)[-1]$ for the strict Roos model, with coordinates $(y,x)$ and differential $(-dy-(1-s)x,dx)$ [lem-weil-strict-roos-comparison]. Let $\eta_U:K\to\mathsf C(U)$ and $\eta_V:K\to\mathsf C(V)$ be induced by the strict quotient and degree-zero Koszul augmentations with zero shifted-product component. Let $F(P)$ and $\eta_K^{\mathrm{intr}}:K\to F(P)$ be the explicit intrinsic Koszul fiber and its unit [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion]. The coordinate map $j_P:F(P)\to\mathsf C(V)$, $(x,y)\mapsto(-y,x)$, is a chain isomorphism sending $\eta_K^{\mathrm{intr}}$ to $\eta_V$. If $a:V\to U$ is induced by the quotient augmentations and $\rho$ is the normalized strict Roos comparison, the natural isomorphism
$$d_K=\rho_U\circ\mathsf C(a)\circ j_P:F(P)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\lim U$$
satisfies $d_K\eta_K^{\mathrm{intr}}=\rho_U\eta_U=\operatorname{comp}_K$, where $\operatorname{comp}_K$ is the canonical derived strict quotient-augmentation map. These identifications descend independently of $P$. If $K$ is derived complete in the prescribed Roos-triangle sense [def-weil-derived-complete], then $\eta_U$, $\operatorname{comp}_K$ and the actual intrinsic unit $\eta_K^{\mathrm{intr}}$ are isomorphisms. No boundedness, constructibility or finiteness condition on $W$ is assumed. For every $r\in\mathbf Z$, $K[r]$ is again Roos-triangle derived complete whenever $K$ is, and the same conclusions apply to its shifted representative $P[r]$.
